About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Chemical Quality & Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) Are you
ready to design, build, and run a state-of-the-art analytical
chemistry laboratory from the ground up? As a Chemical Quality &
Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you will be key to establishing
our chemical laboratory infrastructure in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will manage our analytical instruments, set up
testing standards, and verify the quality of incoming materials and
facility chemical systems. Collaborating closely with our advanced
teams in Taiwan and leading a small group of local technicians, you
will directly safeguard the production quality of Europe's newest
premier semiconductor fab! Tasks Lab Infrastructure Setup: Design,
establish, and optimize our on-site chemical lab capacity, process
setups, and analytical capabilities. Instrument Management: Lead the
operation, calibration, and maintenance of high-precision analytical
equipment, with a focus on ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, and Ion
Chromatography (IC). Material Quality Control: Execute routine and
event-triggered monitoring of incoming chemicals and raw materials to
ensure strict compliance with manufacturing standards. Technical
Writing: Define Operational Instructions (OIs) and Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs) for the laboratory environment. Team Leadership:
Supervise, train, and coordinate a small, dedicated group of
laboratory technicians. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with
fab and facility teams to troubleshoot chemical events, support
continuous improvement projects (CIP), and verify tool certifications.
Emergency On-Duty Support: Participate in weekend and night-shift
on-duty rotations to handle urgent chemical safety or quality
escalations. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s
degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, or a
related scientific discipline. Technical Experience: 0 to 3 years of
hands-on experience in chemical analysis, with deep knowledge of
analytical techniques such as ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, or Ion
Chromatography (IC). Analytical Skillset: Experience in standard
sample preparation, calibration curves, statistical process control
(SPC) data interpretation, and analytical instrument troubleshooting.
Soft Skills: Strong collaborative mindset, intercultural openness,
resilience under pressure, and a structured, detail-oriented approach
to safety and quality. Languages: Fluency in English (written and
spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Prior experience in a semiconductor
manufacturing environment or cleanroom chemical lab management.
Knowledge of European chemical regulations (such as REACH) and safety
standards. Basic programming skills (e.g., Python, R, or SQL) for
analytical data processing. Basic communication skills in German
and/or Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent
employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of
Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center,
gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating
complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training,
while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An
annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports
classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Supplier Quality Engineer – Semiconductor Materials
(m/f/d) Starting on January 27, you can become a key safeguard for
Europe’s newest, most advanced semiconductor manufacturing process.
As a Supplier Quality Engineer – Semiconductor Materials (m/f/d) at
ESMC, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability
of all incoming materials and services used in our Dresden fabrication
facility. By collaborating with global suppliers and our internal
engineering, procurement, and laboratory teams, you will establish a
stable quality baseline that matches our mother fabs in Taiwan. This
role is an exciting opportunity to combine your technical knowledge of
material science with supplier management and big data analytics to
protect our production from material excursions! Tasks Incoming
Quality Assurance: Establish and maintain a stable statistical
baseline for incoming materials and services to ensure local wafer
quality aligns with our international mother fabs. Supplier Quality
Management: Conduct comprehensive supplier quality system assessments,
onsite audits, risk management, and process change control (PCN)
reviews. Excursion Prevention: Utilize statistical process control
(SPC) data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to proactively
monitor supplier performance and prevent material deviations.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Lead cross-functional troubleshooting
teams alongside suppliers and internal laboratory, facility, and
procurement departments to quickly resolve quality issues.
Cross-Border Alignment: Align requirements and share Best Known
Methods (BKMs) across different time zones, communicating effectively
with internal management and executive supplier representatives.
Continuous Improvement: Build trust-based, professional relationships
with suppliers to encourage proactive transparency and continuous
quality improvements. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or
Master’s degree in Material Science, Material Engineering,
Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related
technical field. Experience: 0 to 3 years of professional experience,
ideally in the semiconductor industry or related high-tech sectors
(e.g., photovoltaics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals). Core Technical
Skills: Familiarity with basic material quality management,
statistical data analysis, or process change control. Interpersonal &
Communication Skills: High intercultural open-mindedness, strong
initiative, and the confidence to communicate effectively with
international teams and senior management. Languages: Fluent in
English (written and spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Practical
experience in semiconductor fabrication operations, process
engineering, or physical/chemical laboratory analysis. Familiarity
with structured problem-solving methods (e.g., 8D, 5 Whys) and
supplier auditing. Basic conversational skills in German and/or
Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent employment
contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's
leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide
you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your
start in Dresden. Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer
Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved
in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on
training, while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health &
Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for
sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: SPC & Metrology Quality Engineer (m/f/d) Are you passionate
about turning complex production data into robust manufacturing
stability? As an SPC & Metrology Quality Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you
will be at the heart of our quality defense team in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will take ownership of the quality, calibration,
and tool matching of inline metrology systems (such as OCD, CDSEM, and
Overlay). Simultaneously, you will drive our Statistical Process
Control (SPC) system enhancements to predict manufacturing risks,
analyze data trends, and prevent process deviations. This role is a
unique opportunity to combine physical engineering with advanced
statistical analysis in a brand-new, state-of-the-art semiconductor
fab. Tasks Metrology Quality Assurance: Oversee the performance and
accuracy of critical inline metrology tools (including CDSEM, OCD, and
Overlay) to ensure stable process measurement. Tool Performance
Matching: Develop, implement, and monitor calibration and cross-fab
matching methods to guarantee uniform measurements across all
metrology tools. SPC System Enhancement: Drive the continuous
improvement of SPC systems, including control limit setup, CPK
monitoring, process audits, and data analysis. Statistical Analysis &
Risk Prevention: Apply advanced statistical methods (such as Design of
Experiments (DOE), sampling plans, and reliability modeling) to
predict risks and resolve quality issues. Data-Driven Development:
Program and develop custom statistical algorithms and analysis scripts
to automate quality monitoring and defense reporting. HQ
Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams at our Taiwan
headquarters to align local metrology and SPC standards with global
best practices. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or
Master’s degree in Material Engineering, Statistics, Industrial
Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field.
Professional Background: 0 to 3 years of experience in high-tech
manufacturing, ideally within the semiconductor industry. Statistical
Foundation: Strong knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC)
procedures, CPK analysis, and statistical evaluation techniques.
Programming Skills: Proficiency in statistical software/programming
languages such as JMP or R. Languages: Fluent in English (written and
spoken) for everyday communication in our international company.
Onboarding: Readiness to participate in an extended, hands-on training
assignment in Taiwan. Nice-to-Have: Hands-on experience with metrology
tools (CDSEM, OCD, or Overlay inspection systems). Programming skills
in Python. A certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt. Basic
conversational skills in German and/or Mandarin. We offer Help build a
completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. Work in a
highly international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan
and the US. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing
structures. Participate in global projects and cross-functional
collaboration. International onboarding including 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your
english resume.

The Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP) in Bochum is a research institute of the Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science. It conducts interdisciplinary research on the diverse aspects of IT security and data protection. The newly established and expanding institute will ultimately comprise 18 research groups and employ around 200 staff members and guests. The institute cooperates with the Faculty of Computer Science at Ruhr University Bochum. Bochum is one of the world’s leading research locations for cybersecurity and is home to Europe’s largest training center in this field as well as a vibrant start-up scene.

Starting immediately, we are seeking a

Project Coordinator - AI Competition (d/f/m), 50%

to support the organization, communication, and implementation of an AI competition. The competition combines cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity with the goal of advancing AI-based cybersecurity technologies. Teams from academia, start-ups, and industry will develop autonomous AI-based systems for identifying software vulnerabilities and assessing their exploitability.

The position is part-time (50%) and project-funded until the end of December 2028.

Competition Organization: Coordinate the organizational implementation of the tournament, including deadlines, participant communication, documentation, and organizational workflows.
Participant Management: Serve as an organizational point of contact for participating teams and prospective applicants; coordinate inquiries, registration processes, information materials, and communication throughout the competition.
Event Management: Plan and organize several events, in particular the qualification event and the final tournament. This includes venues, logistics, infrastructure, schedules, invitations, and coordination with external service providers.
Communication and Outreach: Develop and coordinate communication activities to increase awareness of the tournament among universities, research institutions, start-ups, companies, and the broader cybersecurity and AI communities. Identify and address relevant target groups and support targeted outreach activities to attract strong teams.
Website and Communication Materials: Coordinate and prepare content for the project website, newsletters, flyers, posters, social media, and other communication channels.
Public Relations: Coordinate media and public-relations activities around major project milestones and events in collaboration with MPI-SP’s communication structures and the project partners. Support communication and coordination with industry partners, policymakers, and other relevant stakeholders.
Project Coordination: Support meetings, schedules, documentation, reporting, and other organizational aspects of the project and ensure effective communication between the scientific team, project partners, participants, and external stakeholders.

A Master’s degree or comparable qualification, preferably in communication, event management, project management, science management, or a related field.
Experience in project coordination, event organization, communication, or public relations.
Excellent organizational and project-management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.
The ability to communicate professionally with researchers, companies, public-sector organizations, and other external stakeholders.
A proactive, reliable, and solution-oriented working style.
Confidence in using standard digital communication and collaboration tools.

Experience in science communication, research organizations, technology competitions, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, or publicly funded research projects is advantageous but not required.

An independent and varied position at the intersection of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, re...

Doctoral Position: Gene Expression Regulation (f/m/x)

Uhlirova Lab | Institute for Genetics | CECAD

We are one of the largest and oldest universities in Europe and one of the most important employers in our region. Our broad range of subjects, the dynamic development of our main research areas and our central location in Cologne make us attractive for students and researchers from around the world. We offer a wide range of career opportunities in science, technology, and administration.

The Uhlirova lab (www.uni-koeln.de/inter-fak/cecad/uhlirova/) explores how stress-inducible signaling pathways control gene expression and influence tissue homeostasis and longevity. To tackle these questions, we combine the power of functional genetics in Drosophila and mouse models with cutting-edge molecular and cell biology, multi-omics approaches, advanced microscopy, and bioinformatics. We are looking for a highly motivated and curious doctoral candidate (f/m/x) to join our dynamic team. You will have the opportunity to lead your own project, contribute to collaborative research, and develop skills at the interface of genetics, molecular and cell biology, and systems-level analysis.

The University of Cologne promotes equal opportunities and diversity. Women will be considered preferentially in accordance with the Equal Opportunities Act of North Rhine-Westphalia (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz - LGG NRW). We also expressly welcome applications from all suitable candidates regardless of their gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, age, personal orientation and identity.

The position is available from immediately on a part-time basis (25,89 hours per week).The position is to be filled for three years. If the applicant meets the relevant wage requirements and personal qualifications, the salary is based on remuneration group 13 TV-L of the pay scale for the German public sector.

Please apply online without a photo with proof of the required
qualifications and the following documents:

A cover letter describing your motivation to join our research group and information on your career achievements (1 page max.)
Academic Curriculum Vitae, including your publication list and contact information for three references
Copies of your degree and qualification certificate

The reference number is Wiss2608-13. The application deadline is 27 September 2026.
For further inquiries, please contact Dr Esther Wollert (uhlirova-jobs@uni-koeln.de) and take a look at our FAQs. YOUR TASKS

To study the crosstalk between transcription and pre-mRNA splicing under physiological, stress, and disease conditions
To investigate mechanisms underlying spliceosome assembly and functional plasticity
To uncover what renders different transcripts, cells, and tissues sensitive to aberrant splicing
To investigate how spliceosome malfunction contributes to loss of tissue homeostasis, premature aging and diseases
YOUR PROFILE

Completed Master‘s degree or equivalent in Biology / Biochemistry/ Biophysics or related areas of Life Sciences
Strong background in genetics, molecular and cell biology is essential
Motivation, curiosity and creativity, and a strong ability to solve problems through critical analytical thinking
Proven ability to carry out an independent scientific project and unwavering commitment to high quality research
Hands-on experience in working with model organisms, preferably Drosophila and/or mouse and cell culture systems
Excellent communication skills, fluency in spoken and written English
Strong commitment to collaboration and teamwork

DESIRED ASSETS

Hands-on experience in multi-omics research projects and data analysis
Experience with protein purification and biomolecular interaction assays
Interest in computational modeling of biomolecular interactions
Experience in quantitative image analysis and attention to detail
Strong organizational and thorough ...

Academic councils (m/f/x)

We at Yara are part of a global network, collaborating to profitably and responsibly solve some of the world's key challenges - resource scarcity, food insecurity and environmental change.

About the Unit

Within Yara, Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D leads the development and innovation of our crop nutrition solutions. We generate scientific and agronomic insights through laboratory, greenhouse, and field trials; translate these into product concepts and development projects, and support the wider organization with robust, evidence-based knowledge.

We are seeking a curious, proactive, and impact-driven scientist to advance our product development and innovation pipeline for new fertilizers and sustainable technologies that complement and strengthen Yara’s premium crop nutrition portfolio. This role is an integral member of the Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D team and reports to the R&D Lead - Premium Products and Organics.

Scientist - Crop Nutrition Products (f/m/d)

Location: Dülmen, NW, DE
Area of Expertise: Research and Technology Product Development
Job Type: Permanent
Work mode (place): On-site + Home office
Job Requisition ID: 24724

Design and coordinate R&D projects focused on developing high-efficiency phosphorous (P) and nitrogen (N) fertilizer product candidates.
Plan, coordinate and execute internal and external research on agronomic efficiency, nutrient release, soil quality and the environmental impact of fertilizer product candidates.
Develop and implement methods to evaluate the mode of action and performance of new crop nutrition products.
Perform screening and proof-of-concept testing for products and technologies originating from scouting activities and third-party collaborations.
Represent Yara at scientific and technical events, industry associations, and forums related to new fertilizer technologies.
Collaborate with the Premium Products and Organics R&D Team and the broader Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D organization by contributing to additional projects as needed.

Master’s degree plus relevant applied research or industry experience in crop nutrition, soil science, fertilizers, or related fields. A PhD in agronomy, soil science, crop science, plant nutrition, plant physiology or a related discipline is a plus.
Deep understanding of N and P chemistry in soils, nutrient dynamics, and mechanisms of nutrient uptake, transport and assimilation in plants.
Strong scientific grounding in crop nutrition, soil processes, and agronomy, gained through academic research or professional R&D experience.
Knowledge of soil and fertilizer chemistry and plant physiological processes, with the ability to apply these concepts to product development.
Fundamental knowledge of fertilizer products (e.g., soil- and foliar-applied fertilizers, liquids, water-soluble fertilizers, fertigation products, coatings, and seed treatments) and application techniques/equipment.
Hands-on experience conducting laboratory, greenhouse, and/or field experiments, and proficiency in experimental design, analysis and interpretation of complex datasets.
Ability to translate scientific insights into practical recommendations for Yara’s premium crop nutrition products.
Collaborative mindset and ability to work in multidisciplinary and international teams.
Fluency in English; German is a plus.
The position is full-time, permanent, and based in Duelmen, Germany.

As a global organization we actively strive to reflect diversity in society. We therefore encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to creating a work environment that fits gender equality.

Permanent employment contract with industry-standard remuneration

NewTech stands for next-generation technologies and new markets. To ensure our electrified and hydrogen-based solutions succeed globally, service must be designed as a core value driver from day one.

As Service Coordinator, BU NewTech, you will play a pivotal, build-up role at the interface between Business Unit NewTech and Business Unit Service. You will define, establish and scale the global service strategy for NewTech products, ensuring service readiness globally throughout the entire product lifecycle. You will also be responsible for the service specialists of NewTech (or similar).

You will act as the single point of contact for all service-related topics from a NewTech perspective, embedding service into product development, market entry and go-to-market decisions - while leveraging the existing global service organization as a strategic partner.

Key activities include:

- Design, own and continuously develop the global service strategy and concepts for NewTech products in cooperation with relevant stakeholders from BU Service and BU NewTech, ensuring our aspired customer experience and growth ambitions
- Translate product, market and customer requirements into scalable, competitive and executable service concepts
- Act as the central interface between BU NewTech and BU Service across the full product lifecycle; represent service interests in NewTech Product Creation Process (NPCP) and project governance bodies
- Responsible for BU NewTech internal service specialist
- Shape go-to-market decisions from a service perspective, including definition of relevant markets and derivation of required service capabilities per market (e.g. technicians, spare parts, tools, systems, training)
- Plan, prioritize and steer all service-related work packages within NewTech projects, ensuring on-time and market-ready delivery
- Ensure a smooth service operation from market entry to series operation by aligning organization, processes, systems and operational workflows
- Assess service and operations readiness of new products prior to market launch (“What is marketable from a service perspective – and what is not?”)
- Support introduction and pricing of NewTech service offerings
- Ensure consistent, user-friendly and market-ready service documentation is available in a way that works with the standard DEUTZ Service applications (e.g. Serpic)
- Ensure and enable diagnostic capabilities of NewTech products, including implementation of FoTa solutions for systems and batteries in a way that works with the standard DEUTZ Service applications (e.g. Serdia 4.0)
- Develop service upselling models, contributing to sustainable, scalable service revenue streams
- Support the target-oriented build-up and continuous development of the global service organization for NewTech products in alignment with BU Service.
- Support Service Network Development on identifying white Spots for NewTech Customers
- Responsible for NewTech service technicians

Qualifications & Experience:

- University degree in (Industrial) Engineering, Business Administration, Service Management or a comparable qualification
- At least five years of professional experience in service, after-sales, or project-based environments, ideally within industrial, automotive or mechanical engineering sectors
- Proven experience in cross-functional interface roles between Service, Sales, R&D, and Product Management e.g. in product development or market launch projects
- End-to-end understanding of service topics across the product lifecycle, particularly spare parts, service documentation, diagnostics and service concepts
- Experience in planning and steering work packages within projects
- Familiarity with diagnostic systems and digital service tools (e.g. SerDia, FoTa or comparable solutions) is an advantage
- Ability to structure complex technical and organizational requirements and translate them into market-ready service and operations concepts
- Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills
- Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style
- Fluent German and English, written and spoken

Working Conditions:

- Location: Oss (Netherlands) or Cologne/Aachen region (Germany)
- Date of entry: Immediately
- Predominantly office-based with hybrid working options by agreement
- Full-time position (40 hours per week)
- Contract type: Permanent
- Up to 20% travel

We are looking for a driven Channel/Partner Marketing Manager to strengthen and grow our EcoXpert partner network for Schneider Electric’s KNX solutions. In this role you will design impactful channel strategies, enable partners to succeed and drive sustainable sales growth across key markets.

If you enjoy building strong partnerships, developing effective programs and turning insights into measurable results. This is a great opportunity to make a real impact.

**All key information at a glance:** 

- **When and where?**As soon as possible in Wiehl 
- **Duration:**Unlimited 
- **Vacation:**30 days
- **Weekly hours:**40
- **Your contact person?**Peter Müller, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner 

Our Benefits:

- Work with purpose! We are a Green Company with a strong sense of responsibility and sustainability
- Innovation: We don’t just keep up with the times – we actively shape them
- Gain hands-on experience with a new SAP system (Unify) in an international environment
- A job with a future: Plan your long-term career with us and grow according to your own ambitions

- Strong understanding of the EcoXpert partner program and its benefits for partners and Schneider Electric 
- Proven track record of building and managing successful channel partner networks 
- Excellent communication, relationship-building and negotiation skills to cultivate strong partnerships 
- Experience in developing and delivering channel enablement programs, including training and sales support tools 
- Fluency in English with strong German language skills

**Your next step? Apply online!** 

Apply now, even if you don’t (yet) meet all the requirements. We look forward to getting to know you! Please upload your CV including certificates and salary expectations. 

**Learn more:** 

Find us on Instagram at @schneiderelectric_karriere to stay up to date.

HypoVereinsbank is part of UniCredit, a pan-European Commercial Bank. Our purpose is to empower communities to progress by delivering the best-in-class for our corporate and retail clients worldwide, unlocking their potential and that of our employees. Digitalisation and our commitment to the ESG principles - sustainability & social justice - are key enablers for our actions. They guide us in accompanying and empowering our stakeholders. Through our sustainability strategy, our products, as well as through social impact banking, we contribute to a future worth living. Our success is based on the diversity and uniqueness of our employees. That is why we respect and promote equal opportunities in all dimensions of diversity, equity and inclusion: ranging from age and gender to nationality and religion. jobs.description:
PhD Candidate (f/m/x) in Ophthalmic Epidemiology
Code: 1547/2026/5

full-time, 3 years, extension possible
Site: Bonn

The German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) is a globally leading, internationally oriented research institution dedicated to discovering new approaches for the prevention and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. Conduct research in ophthalmic epidemiology of aging in humans, with a focus on age-related macular degeneration. In particular, we expect you to:

Perform integrative analyses combining multi-omics data with eye imaging data
Contribute to ophthalmic data collection and processing
Contribute to omics data processing, statistical analyses, and the preparation of manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals
Present research findings at national and international conferences
Actively participate in project-related meetings, documentation, and reporting of project progress
Contribute to ongoing projects within the group and develop independent research ideas

A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field, such as epidemiology, bioinformatics, medicine, biomedical sciences, or a related discipline
A genuine interest in scientific research and quantitative analysis
Strong proficiency in written and spoken English
Statistical knowledge and experience with programming in R
Experience with epidemiological research or large-scale observational studies, particularly involving omics and eye imaging data, including the application of machine learning methods for pattern recognition and predictive modeling is desirable but not a prerequisite
Strong analytical skills, independent and critical thinking, and attention to detail
Flexibility, strong interpersonal skills, and enjoyment of working in an interdisciplinary and international team
Proficiency in written and spoken German

Your role in Cutting-Edge Research

The PhD project will be supervised by Dr. Dr. Petra Larsen, scientific lead of the ophthalmic epidemiology team. The research is embedded in the large population-based Rhineland Study, a comprehensive long-term cohort investigating determinants of brain health. We are seeking an enthusiastic and ambitious early-career researcher (f/m/x) with a strong interest in investigating multi-omic and eye imaging signatures in the context of age-related macular degeneration.

The Ophthalmic Epidemiology research team investigates deep phenotyping of retinal ageing, preclinical changes and disease, as well as the comprehensive assessment of risk factors driving the onset and progression of both preclinical and clinical disease. These include genetic, molecular and environmental factors.

The PhD thesis will focus on the relationship between ageing and age-related macular degeneration and encompass the full breadth of scientific work, including the development and implementation of study protocols, coordination and supervision of data collection, and data analysis and publication.

The project will leverage data from the Rhineland Study, a deeply-phenotyped, large-scale population-based cohort study. Available data include comprehensive multi-omics data, including (epi)genomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, and proteomics; eye imaging data, advanced MRI data as well as extensive behavioral and clinical data, including cognitive and neurological assessments, cardiovascular assessments, medical history, and medication use. The study currently includes over 14,000 individuals, of whom more than 6,000 already have longitudinal data. Additional baseline and follow-up data collection is ongoing.
